x2_operational_negatives.title: Recover a predecessor builder inspection that exceeded the output budget
x2_operational_negatives.failure: A full read of the predecessor evidence builder exceeded the available tool and context output, so the tail was truncated.
x2_operational_negatives.failed_procedure: Read the entire predecessor evidence builder as one output payload.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: Index functions first, then read only the function or bounded line range needed for the current implementation.
x2_operational_negatives.passing_observed: The function index and targeted ranges exposed the reusable lifecycle without claiming that truncated content was reviewed.
x2_operational_negatives.guard: Estimate output size before reading large generated builders and prefer function-level inspection.
x2_operational_negatives.rollback: Discard the incomplete read as authoritative evidence and repeat only the bounded relevant inspection.

x2_operational_negatives.title: Split a parallel inspection whose per-command timeout was too short
x2_operational_negatives.failure: A parallel status and script-index probe used ten-second per-command limits and timed out before returning its results.
trigger: several cold PowerShell and Git probes
x2_operational_negatives.failed_procedure: Run three cold inspection commands in parallel with a ten-second timeout each.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: Repeat the read-only probes with bounded sixty-second command limits and preserve each result separately.
x2_operational_negatives.passing_observed: The repeated probes completed, showed the x1 head clean and remote-aligned, and returned the script indexes.
x2_operational_negatives.guard: Use realistic per-command limits for cold Windows repository probes while keeping user updates below sixty seconds.
x2_operational_negatives.rollback: Terminate only the timed-out diagnostic and make no repository mutation.

x2_operational_negatives.title: Replace aggregate bounded reads that still exceeded the combined output limit
x2_operational_negatives.failure: Several individually bounded script ranges were combined into one response whose aggregate output was still truncated.
x2_operational_negatives.failed_procedure: Treat bounded component ranges as automatically safe when combined into one large response.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: Inspect one function at a time or query compact symbols and shapes programmatically.
x2_operational_negatives.passing_observed: Compact indexes and machine-readable summaries exposed the required schemas without another aggregate dump.
x2_operational_negatives.guard: Budget aggregate output as well as each component output.
x2_operational_negatives.rollback: Do not infer unseen content from the truncation; request only the missing narrow segment.

x2_operational_negatives.title: Introspect frozen definition symbols before assuming predecessor names
x2_operational_negatives.failure: A compact definition probe guessed SAFE_NOW_TASKS, which does not exist; the frozen module exports SAFE_NOW.
x2_operational_negatives.failed_procedure: Import a guessed collection name without first examining the frozen module namespace.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: List uppercase exported names, then query SAFE_NOW, CANDIDATES, SKILLS, RUNNERS, and CLEAN_TASKS directly.
x2_operational_negatives.passing_observed: Namespace inspection identified all frozen collections and their exact counts without modifying x1.
x2_operational_negatives.guard: Inspect frozen exported names before writing phase builders that import them.
x2_operational_negatives.rollback: Retain the AttributeError as an operational negative and use the discovered immutable symbol names.

x2_operational_negatives.title: Keep the x2 Method Flow append separate from the immutable x1 state path
x2_operational_negatives.failure: The first scoped replay failed because x2 rewrote method-flow-state.json from six to ten methods, while the frozen x1 test correctly required the x1 artifact to remain at six.
x2_operational_negatives.failed_procedure: Write the combined x1 plus x2 Method Flow state back over the frozen x1 state path.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: Restore the exact x1 state from the immutable x1 Git blob and write the combined append-only state to method-flow-state-x2.json.
x2_operational_negatives.passing_observed: The frozen x1 state again contains six methods while the separate x2 state retains every x1 method plus all x2 failures and recoveries.
x2_operational_negatives.guard: Treat every x1 path as immutable after the remote-equal freeze; use phase-lifecycle suffixes for x2 state.
x2_operational_negatives.rollback: Restore only the exact x1 blob, retain the failed replay, and rerun all scoped x1 and x2 modules.

boundary: Operational and mutation negatives are retained evidence of bounded failure handling, not scientific replication.
